parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A description for the data source, limited to 128 characters.

parameters.name: DgInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Database Gateway (DG) instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the database instance.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the database host.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded password for the database user.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the database host.

parameters.name: Schema
parameters.description: The name of the database. Specifying this parameter restricts data migration or data synchronization to this database.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the data source. Valid values include `INTERNET`, `VPC`, `RDS`, `PolarDB`, and `DG`.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username of the database user for data migration or data synchronization.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the VPC.
